evidence.detail: Client's privileged ::testregion command loads a target region, then calls rs/e.b() to write the captured data and rs/e.a() to clear the saved map/position cache.
rs/e derives a region id from world coordinates using (x >> 6) * 256 + (y >> 6), deduplicates positions by x/y/plane, and groups records by that region id.
The class writes one binary file per captured region beneath the hard-coded ./clipdump/ root using DataOutputStream, then prints "Dump successful!".
The class contains the diagnostics "Cleared saved map and position cache!", "Dumping <n> regions..", and "Dump successful!".

candidates.note: RegionClipDumper is the conservative semantic recovery name for the exact v308 ::testregion clip/map-position capture utility; it does not claim a verbatim original identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/e$a is a five-field value record containing four ints and one boolean, constructed directly from the worldX, worldY, plane, collisionFlags and object-blocking/collision metadata captured by rs/e.
rs/e.b() iterates these records and serializes all four integer fields plus boolean state into each region clipdump file.

candidates.note: RegionClipRecord is the conservative semantic recovery name for the value object serialized by RegionClipDumper.
